evidence.result: A real timeline image was moved offline, detected in the library, timeline, and canvas, then relinked through the browser with the same media id. The restored bytes matched the original SHA-256 and the clip retained transforms and four keyframes.
Versioned goal plan and portable HTML report rendered in the in-app browser, screenshot lightbox worked, and no browser console warning or error was recorded.
Filename search returned 1 of 44 assets, type filtering returned 6 of 44 assets, and edit modes displayed current shortcut labels.
Existing atomic operation registry, project inspection, revision and idempotency checks, and guardrail schema tests accepted as the agent foundation.
